title: The Clear Pipes — a water-computer keep
license_note: Original Mag module. Lukyanov/MONIAC isomorphism, not a replica. Engine owns heights.

gallery.name: The Sight-Glass Gallery
gallery.desc: Three tanks behind glass: SOURCE, WORK, OUT. Clear pipes. Gravity is the only computer. A plaque: height is the computation. A bucket on a far hook would be a lie.
hooks: Plaque: height is the computation. A bucket into OUT is not a win.
Pump-Janitor: I move water. I do not pour. Hire me and I tick once.

source_cistern.name: Source Cistern
source_cistern.desc: Rain water stacked three marks high. Valve A on the pipe east toward WORK. Closed, nothing flows. Open, gravity takes a mark each wait.
source_cistern.environment: Wet stone; the only full tank at dawn
hooks: Valve-A: pipe to WORK. Say open valve or close valve.
Pump-Janitor: Check valve holds. I will not fill OUT from a bucket.

work_gallery.name: Work Integrator
work_gallery.desc: The middle tank. This is where the dam's heat would have been. Valve B on the pipe north-east toward OUT. Empty until SOURCE has run.
hooks: Valve-B: pipe to OUT. Open only after water has arrived, or both valves siphon.

out_cistern.name: Output Cistern
out_cistern.desc: The answer tank. Empty glass. A wooden bucket hangs here — the cheat. Pouring fills the height without the pipes. Physics will call it DISPUTED. A downstream door: glass, impossible, north-bank cold. It only opens for carried height.
hooks: The Bucket: pour bucket to fake a height. That is not computation.
out_cistern.invariant: water-feeds-field (RIB_CATHEDRAL_WORLD_V1: OUT.height is fractal leaf_gate entry, AGREE) — gated by engine on refraction

rest_safe.text: A drip counts time. Gravity does not need you watching.
You dream of plywood painted like a tank. You wake and check the glass.
